verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph provides an official, well-documented SDK/API surface for OneDrive (driveItem operations, delta query, change notifications, upload sessions, search, sharing links, thumbnails) that developers—including AI-native builders—can build against. Missing for 10: no explicit mention of dedicated first-party SDK packages (e.g., Graph SDK client libraries) or AI-agent-specific tooling, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of SDK developer experience; probes show no llms.txt/openapi discovery aids.
